title: Modular Scanner & Detection Engine Architecture
summary: Comprehensive architectural refactoring of the on-device detection and scanning engine, establishing clean domain module boundaries, dedicated types and constants, and unified orchestration without altering algorithms or detection accuracy.

changes.text: Scanner Engine Orchestration: extracted unified screenshot scanning pipeline, multi-screenshot row stitching, and GOOD format mapping into dedicated engine modules under lib/scanner.
Grid Detection Modularization: split monolithic grid types into focused geometry, settings, and grid models, and centralized parameter thresholds into domain constants.
Card Recognition Clean-up: organized recognition types into focused models (bank, rarity, quantity, mora, settings) and centralized card geometry and atlas specifications.
Video Scanner Architecture: organized keyframe selection heuristics, sighting voting consensus, and video stream decoding with dedicated types and constants.
Type Safety & Formatting: eliminated loose types, documented domain entities in lib/types.ts, and formatted all engine files to repository code standards.
